name: Lordless
source:
There is no happy ending.
There is no light at the end of the tunnel.
I'm sorry I can give you nothing more than this blessing.
Maybe one day you will forgive me.

Follow Riot as he desperately rips and tears  through the trials of Lordless, a kinetic soulsborne inspired visual novel. While it is not anywhere as unforgiving to the player, the world itself is unforgiving to Riot, and any wrong move will result in him dying in unique, gruesome ways.


[From [url=https://judithan.itch.io/lordless]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
没有幸福的结局。
隧道尽头也没有光。
抱歉，除了这份祝福，我什么也给不了你。
也许有一天，你会原谅我。

跟随莱奥特，在《Lordless》的重重试炼中拼命杀出一条血路。这是一部受魂系游戏启发、无选项的视觉小说。虽然它对玩家并没有那么苛刻，但这个世界对莱奥特毫不留情，任何一步走错，都可能让他以一种独特而惨烈的方式死去。

[摘自[url=https://judithan.itch.io/lordless]itch.io[/url]]
